@image1 — Rosa, 67: face, hair and build only.
@image2 — Michelle, 63: face, hair and build only.
@image3 — the entry hall: copy it — the white front door at the end, the round brass mirror over the console on the left wall, the archway on the right, the globe pendant in the middle.
@audio1 — Rosa's voice.

SHOT: A warm animated family drama: in the hall Rosa turns her sister round from the mirror and tells her it was never her age, it was the foundation; one take of 6 shots, 9:16, 21 s.

TIMELINE
[0–2s] Shot 1 · medium, locked: Frame 1: Michelle at the round mirror over the console, Rosa just behind her under the pendant, the wine on the console — Rosa's hands turn Michelle round by the shoulders. Rosa says: "Can I tell you something?"
[2–6s] Shot 2 · medium close-up, slow pan: Rosa's hand lifts to her own cheek and lowers; the pan follows. Rosa says: "Two years ago, I felt exactly like that. Same mirror, same thoughts."
[6–9s] Shot 3 · medium, slow creep in: her eyes rise from the floor to Rosa's face; the camera creeps in.
[9–12s] Shot 4 · medium close-up, slow creep in: Rosa leans in one step closer; the camera creeps in. Rosa says: "And I will tell you what I had to learn the hard way."
[12–16s] Shot 5 · close-up, slow push-in: her brows lift on 'never'; the camera pushes in. A beat of stillness first. Rosa says: "It was never your age, Michelle. It was the foundation."
[16–21s] Shot 6 · full shot, tracks alongside: two taps on Rosa's cheek, Michelle's hand rises to hers; the camera tracks a little sideways. Rosa says: "Made for young skin, so on ours it just sits on top and ages us." Last frame: Rosa and Michelle face to face under the pendant in profile, Rosa's bag on her shoulder.

LOOK: A theatrical 3D animated feature, stylised adults with large expressive eyes, soft skin, sculpted hair, fabric with weight; natural, ungraded colour; light from the globe pendant light in the hall, a shadow side on every face. Rosa: the marigold-orange wrap blouse and long ink-blue skirt, tan sandals; Michelle: an old oversized faded-grey sweatshirt over charcoal pull-on trousers, grey felt slippers, hair limp.

SOUND: Dialogue in natural American English — Rosa's voice from @audio1; only the person written as speaking speaks, and on every other shot nobody speaks. No music. The actions' own sounds: Rosa's bracelets, their slippers and sandals on the hall floor, a breath; the quiet hall at night under it.

KEEP: same faces, hair and clothes in every frame; just Rosa and Michelle in the scene; text, logos and captions nowhere; five fingers on each hand; real weight and timing; eyes off the lens
